paper.title: Cascade Decoders-Based Autoencoders for Image Reconstruction

result.summary: 本文针对自编码器研究目标偏向特征表示、忽视数据恢复性能评估、难以实现无损重建等问题，提出以图像重建为目标、采用级联解码器结构的自编码器 [abstract]。所提出的串行解码器自编码器包含多级解码器架构及相关优化算法，级联解码器由通用解码器、残差解码器、对抗解码器及其组合构成 [abstract]。实验结果表明，所提出的自编码器在图像重建性能上优于经典自编码器 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在解决自编码器的图像重建问题，因为当前自编码器存在研究目标不是数据重建而是特征表示、数据恢复性能评估被忽视、纯自编码器甚至纯深度学习难以实现无损数据重建等缺点 [abstract]。其动机是为基于自编码器的图像压缩和压缩感知提供坚实的理论与应用基础 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: The main disadvantages of current autoencoders comprise the following several aspects: the research objective is not data reconstruction but feature representation
the performance evaluation of data recovery is neglected
it is hard to achieve lossless data reconstruction by pure autoencoders, even by pure deep learning
This paper aims for image reconstruction of autoencoders
provides solid theory and application basis for autoencoders-based image compression and compressed sensing

method.text: 论文采用级联解码器（cascade decoders）的自编码器，提出串行解码器自编码器，包括多级解码器架构及相关优化算法 [abstract]。级联解码器由通用解码器、残差解码器、对抗解码器及其组合构成 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: The proposed serial decoders-based autoencoders include the architectures of multi-level decoders and the related optimization algorithms.
The cascade decoders consist of general decoders, residual decoders, adversarial decoders and their combinations.

findings.text: 实验结果表明，所提出的自编码器在图像重建性能上优于经典自编码器 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: It is evaluated by the experimental results that the proposed autoencoders outperform the classical autoencoders in the performance of image reconstruction.
